statement: Closed FIELD_REGISTRY default rules must be applied in the Section 14.5 listed order.
A field defined in Section 15 must use its Section 15 row and Section 15 value contracts.

Subject to earlier closed defaults, STAGE_DECISION, DECISION_EVIDENCE, and every *_DETERMINATION, CONTROLLING_REASON, CONTROLLING_EVIDENCE, and FINAL_* field must be an APPLICATION-derived gate summary.

Subject to earlier closed defaults, every count, coverage, or completeness field, including TOTAL_*, *_COVERAGE, ALL_*, EXPECTED_*, ACTUAL_*, MISSING_*, EXECUTED, SATISFIED, VIOLATED, UNDETERMINED, and RUNS, must be an APPLICATION-derived summary under Sections 14.1 and 16.2.
Subject to earlier closed defaults, every *_RECORDS field must be a Section 14.8 projection of its owning Section 38 family.
For a *_RECORDS field governed by closed default rule 4, substantive ownership must follow its owning Section 38 family's declared partitions.
Subject to earlier closed defaults, every *_VERSION and *_ID field must be an APPLICATION-allocated identity under Section 34.2 or its owning version registry.
Subject to earlier closed defaults, fields assigned by Sections 14.2, 14.3, and 14.6 must follow those assignments.
Subject to earlier closed defaults, every remaining stage field must be an APPLICATION-recomputed summary or immutable reference under Section 14.8.
Substantive agent or human content must never exist as a bare stage field and must live only in its owning family.
A field whose contract is neither explicitly specified nor uniquely produced by the closed default rules must be classified UNDEFINED_FIELD_CONTRACT.
A field whose contract is neither explicitly specified nor uniquely produced by the closed default rules must block specification acceptance.
An UNDEFINED_FIELD_CONTRACT must be resolved by a specification change, never an implementation choice.
